components.css: .scene-choice{display:block;padding:19px 22px;border-radius:7px;background:#dfbd79;color:#292419;border:1px solid #e9ce99;font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 12px 28px #0003;transition:transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1),background-color 180ms ease}.scene-choice strong{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:650}.scene-choice span{font-size:12px}.scene-choice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #f5d58e;outline-offset:5px}.scene-choice:active{transform:scale(.985)}@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.scene-choice:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);background:#ebcd91}.scene-choice:hover:active{transform:scale(.985)}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.scene-choice{transition:background-color 120ms ease,color 120ms ease}}

keyCharacteristics: Real crest with traced gold edge
dos: Keep all primary information directly available.
Preserve ordinary scroll, body readability, no-JS visibility, direct hashes, and authoritative data.
narrative.overview: The cinematic citadel and Helga lead into a continuous, directly readable Welcome. The real NRW standard traces its gold edge while three localized lines build with native reversible scroll. Primary information is not hidden behind audience selection. Two captioned original AI panoramas and larger real event emblems enrich the world without changing native scroll motion. Editable persisted L1/L2 clocks use the same public schedule authority.

rules.body: Final story styles supersede earlier hidden audience layout; current markup is authoritative.
rules.name: The Cascade Rule

donts: Do not restore hidden audience streams or major information disclosures.
Do not hijack scrolling or invent game rewards or proof.
Do not call AI panoramas game screenshots or overlay factual text on them.
Do not hardcode legion clock fallbacks or restore obsolete polling-time claims.
Do not expand the narrowly authorized legion feature into unrelated backend or leadership changes.
